name: 33905 · Fort Myers, FL
findings: ZIP 33905 (Fort Myers) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
